      • fIdentityConstraint2ValueStoreMap

        protected final Map<XMLSchemaValidator.LocalIDKey,XMLSchemaValidator.ValueStoreBase> fIdentityConstraint2ValueStoreMap
        Values stores associated to specific identity constraints. This map maps IdentityConstraints and the 0-based element on which their selectors first matched to a corresponding ValueStore. This should take care of all cases, including where ID constraints with descendant-or-self axes occur on recursively-defined elements.
